infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: dashFly uses your location to track your runs, rides, and other activities.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: dashFly needs background location to continue tracking your activity when the app is minimized.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: dashFly uses motion data to detect steps and cadence during activities.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: dashFly needs camera access to take profile photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: dashFly needs photo library access to save activity screenshots and upload profile photos.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: dashFly needs microphone access for audio cues during activities.
